_purpose: Deployable site set for the egpt-frqtl PROD app. WITHOUT this manifest the CLI's legacy flow uploads the whole app directory. Site URLs are non-expiring and unsigned, so the set is an explicit ALLOWLIST: SiteWalker treats an empty `include` as match-everything.
_repo_root_excluded: The only source is `site`, so the repo-root assets/, kb/, plugin/, docs/, scripts/ and .descix/ are outside the walk and never uploaded. Do not add them as bare-name excludes: SiteWalker.isDirExcluded matches a bare directory name at ANY depth, so an `assets` exclude would silently drop any assets/ directory inside the bundle. Do not add a source whose path is `.` or a repo-root directory.
_schema_pin: Same schema as the egpt-godsworld worked example, authored against the PUBLISHED @descix/cli@1.0.6 tarball: lib/core/ManifestLoader.js::validateSiteManifest (sources[] non-empty; each {path required string, include?/exclude? string arrays}; buildCommand string|null) and lib/core/SiteWalker.js::walkDir (exclude tested BEFORE include, so exclude wins; isDirExcluded matches the BARE directory name, so directory excludes carry no glob suffix). RE-VERIFY THIS PIN against the CLI actually used at upload time before trusting it.
_two_namespaces: The IDE entry is app.html with its hashed React chunks under app-assets/; every router-resolved engine, vendor, notebook and math URL lives under pub/. The two namespaces are deliberately DISJOINT — serving the sdk dist at root would collide with the IDE's own app.html and the front page index.html. Do not add a source that flattens pub/ to root.
_why_not_apps_ide_dist: apps/ide/dist on its own is HALF A SITE: it carries no pub/ payload and a bare vite build leaves it in DEV-CORE mode, every engine/monaco/notebook/math URL resolving at /frqtl/... and /egpt-src/... which nothing serves on a backend-less host. Nothing in the built bytes announces which mode they are, which is exactly how the wrong bundle reached PROD before and served a dead shell.
